Now I understand the bug. The issue is in `_check_version` at line 306. On Windows, `BASH_VERSION` can contain parentheses like `5.2.12(1)-release`. When the shell command is `echo ${BASH_VERSION}` (without quotes), the parentheses cause a syntax error in bash. The fix wraps it in double quotes: `echo "${BASH_VERSION}"`.
